title: Steven Dick's AI protective layer of Earth idea (Galileo Project)

tellings.quote: I think there's a former NASA guy named Steven Dick who's part of Ovillobe's Galileo project who talks about >> uh this is sort of some sort of AI layer like protective layer of Earth.

plain: The idea is that some kind of artificial intelligence might form a protective layer around Earth. Michels brings it up hesitantly, saying "I think" a former NASA man named Steven Dick talks about it. He places Dick in the Galileo Project, a search for physical evidence of alien technology led by the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb. If true, something watching over the planet would already be here.
